scope.quote: elicitation, representation and validation of requirements

ai_policy.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section

rules.quote: Abbreviations should be defined at first mention
rules.requirement: Define abbreviations at first mention.

rules.quote: should be placed in a separate section on the title page.
rules.requirement: Place acknowledgments on the appropriate title page or submission field, pending system guidance.

rules.quote: responsibility of the author to anonymize the manuscript and any associated materials.
rules.requirement: Anonymize the manuscript and accompanying materials.

rules.quote: avoid citing their own work in a way that could reveal their identity.
rules.requirement: Avoid self citations that identify the authors.

rules.quote: disclose interests that are directly or indirectly related to the work submitted
rules.requirement: Disclose relevant interests through the current submission channel.

rules.quote: explain how to access data supporting the results and analysis
rules.requirement: Explain how supporting data can be accessed.

rules.quote: authorship in the data is also anonymised.
rules.requirement: Anonymize dataset metadata made available to reviewers where feasible.

rules.quote: All original research must include a data availability statement.
rules.requirement: Include a data availability statement for original research.

rules.quote: cite any publicly available data on which the conclusions of the paper rely
rules.requirement: Cite public supporting datasets.

rules.quote: include DOIs as full DOI links in your reference list
rules.requirement: Use full DOI links where available.

rules.quote: provide all relevant editable source files at every submission and revision
rules.requirement: Provide complete editable source files.

rules.quote: approval by the appropriate ethics committee for research involving humans and/or animals
rules.requirement: Disclose ethics approval when human or animal research is involved.

rules.quote: Each figure should have a concise caption
rules.requirement: Provide a concise caption for each figure.

rules.quote: Figures should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite figures in consecutive order.

rules.quote: All figures are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number figures with Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: They should also not contain any figures or tables.
rules.requirement: Do not put figures or tables in footnotes.

rules.quote: Always use footnotes instead of endnotes.
rules.requirement: Use footnotes rather than endnotes.

rules.quote: information regarding sources of funding
rules.requirement: Disclose funding where applicable.

rules.quote: decimal system of headings with no more than three levels
rules.requirement: Use up to three numbered heading levels.

rules.quote: informed consent if the research involved human participants
rules.requirement: Include informed consent information for human participant research.

rules.quote: Authors are advised to use the Springer Nature LaTeX template
rules.requirement: If using LaTeX, use the Springer Nature template; reconcile later Word guidance.

rules.quote: We encourage LaTeX as a submission format.
rules.requirement: Confirm accepted manuscript format; LaTeX is encouraged while Text Formatting also specifies Word.

rules.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, do not currently satisfy our authorship criteria.
rules.requirement: Do not list an LLM as an author.

rules.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section
rules.requirement: Document substantive LLM use in Methods or a suitable alternative section.

rules.quote: identified by numbers in square brackets.
rules.requirement: Use numeric in-text citations in square brackets.

rules.quote: only include works that are cited in the text
rules.requirement: List only cited published or accepted works.

rules.quote: The entries in the list should be numbered consecutively.
rules.requirement: Number references consecutively.

rules.quote: all papers must explicitly address:
rules.requirement: Address practical design consequences and how a practitioner could evaluate the contribution.

rules.quote: Research articles must include some scientific means for evaluating the validity of the subject.
rules.requirement: Include a scientific validity evaluation in a research article.

rules.quote: provide compelling argumentation for any conclusions drawn
rules.requirement: Give convincing reasoning for research-comment conclusions.

rules.quote: must build on evidence (literature, trends, state-of-the-practice)
rules.requirement: Ground research commentaries in evidence.

rules.quote: describe how data can be accessed and any conditions for reuse
rules.requirement: Describe access conditions if data cannot be public.

rules.quote: obtain permission from the copyright owner(s) for both the print and online format
rules.requirement: Obtain reuse permission for previously published material.

rules.quote: A separate Title Page should be submitted
rules.requirement: Prepare a separate title page if the current submission system requests it; the page also says some details belong in interface fields.

rules.quote: using the header \documentclass{sn-jnl}
rules.requirement: If using LaTeX, use the sn-jnl class; confirm applicability given the Word guidance.

rules.quote: For each supplementary material, please supply a concise caption
rules.requirement: Provide a caption for each supplementary file.

rules.quote: text must make specific mention of the material as a citation
rules.requirement: Cite supplementary files in the manuscript.

rules.quote: structured and verifiable manner
rules.requirement: Report literature insights in a structured and verifiable manner.

rules.quote: pertinent to requirements engineering at large
rules.requirement: Keep a systematic review pertinent to requirements engineering.

rules.quote: We expect systematic reviews to fulfill the essential attributes listed by ACM SIGSOFT's standard.
rules.requirement: For a systematic review, satisfy the cited ACM SIGSOFT standard; its attributes require separate source review.

rules.quote: For each table, please supply a table caption
rules.requirement: Provide a caption for each table.

rules.quote: All tables are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number tables using Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: Tables should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite tables in consecutive order.

rules.quote: All tables are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number tables with Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: Use the equation editor or MathType for equations.
rules.requirement: Use Word equation tools for equations in Word submissions.

rules.quote: Use the automatic page numbering function to number the pages.
rules.requirement: Use automatic page numbers in Word submissions.
